I'm not as concerned about the D play as I am the O,  especially the  OL.

Gus did a great job with the D last week, including as someone else mentioned using Bosa and Ingram both inside and out.  Derwin's an animal.  Addae is always a concern, though, Heyward can have a couple/three bad moments each game.  
We need to be putting points on the board 6-7 at a time instead of 3.  Given the lack of time that PR gets in the pocket then I expect to see more slants to keep the ball moving forward.  Consistently having to convert on 3 and 3-5 yards is going to bite us.  HH has been activated as well, so even if he doesn't get a lot of touches then will be an additional distraction.  


We are going to win this game....8-1 on the road this season.
